doc: The single-source taxonomy of every supported optional build-tag combo (#3712, epic #3708).
CI's variant-matrix.yml derives its compile-check matrix FROM THIS FILE (jq in its plan job):
add a variant here and it enrolls in the gate automatically — there is no hand-maintained
YAML list to drift (the DRY lesson from the release flag string, solved for flags by
scripts/build.sh / #3709). Classification, not re-implementation: the invariant that every
`import "C"` file sits behind an opt-in //go:build tag is enforced by internal/architest
(that fencing is WHY the default build can be pure-Go and reproducible), and the arch/device
taxonomy for NEW backends is generated by `fak backend scaffold` (cmd/fak/backendscaffold.go
+ internal/compute/scaffold.go). gate values: 'matrix' = trunk-gating in variant-matrix.yml;
'advisory' = run in variant-matrix.yml with continue-on-error (a wip_ fence hides code that
may legitimately not compile against committed symbols — the internal/buildwitness +
internal/wipfence contract — so it is witnessed, never trunk-gating); 'external' = owned by
a toolchain-specific workflow; 'manual' = dispatch-only GPU runner; 'none' = UNWITNESSED
today, named here so the gap is visible instead of implicit.

variants.name: default
variants.witness: variant-matrix.yml cross-builds every release_targets entry; reproducible.yml double-build byte-identity; cuda-build.yml static job's no-cgo-leak guard

variants.name: wip_sessionfleet
variants.witness: variant-matrix.yml advisory lane (continue-on-error): red means the fenced WIP has drifted from committed symbols, which the wipfence contract permits — visible, not trunk-gating

variants.name: cuda
variants.witness: cuda-build.yml: go vet -tags cuda (toolkit-free header) + nvcc tier compiling kernels and linking go build -tags cuda against stub libs

variants.name: cuda-nccl
variants.witness: UNWITNESSED today — needs NCCL headers/stubs in the nvcc tier; named follow-on of #3712

variants.name: vulkan-windows
variants.witness: UNWITNESSED today — needs a Windows cgo runner + a libfakvulkan.a stub; named follow-on of #3712

variants.name: metal
variants.witness: UNWITNESSED today — needs a macOS arm64 cgo runner; named follow-on of #3712
